message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is a detailed analysis of the interface:

### 1. Page/Screen Identification
The screen shown is the **Employer Dashboard** for a platform called **"SkillMatch AI"**. It serves as the main landing page for an employer to track their hiring activities, view active job postings, and monitor candidate applications.

### 2. Visible Buttons and Interactive Elements
*   **Top Bar:**
    *   **Search Bar:** A text input field with a magnifying glass icon containing the placeholder: "Search jobs, companies, skills..."
    *   **Role Selector:** A dropdown button labeled "Employer" with a shield icon.
    *   **Notification Bell:** An icon with a red badge (indicating unread notifications).
    *   **Messages Icon:** A chat bubble icon.
    *   **User Profile:** A circular avatar with initials "DC", the name "David Chen", email "employer@demo.com", and a logout/exit arrow icon.
*   **Sidebar Navigation:**
    *   **Dashboard:** Currently active/selected item.
    *   **Company Profile**
    *   **Jobs**
    *   **Candidate Ranking**
    *   **Applications**
    *   **Interviews**
    *   **AI Report**
    *   **Messages**
    *   **Notifications:** Features a purple circular badge with the number "2".
    *   **User Avatar (Bottom Left):** A dark circle with the letter "N".
*   **Main Content Area:**
    *   **"+ Post a job" Button:** A primary action button located at the top right of the main content.
    *   **"View all →":** A link to see all jobs.
    *   **"All →":** A link to see all recent candidates.
    *   **Job Listing Cards:**
        *   "Backend Engineer (Go)" card (with an arrow icon).
        *   "Senior Frontend Engineer" card (with an arrow icon).

### 3. Error Messages, Blank Areas, or Broken UI Elements
*   **Empty State Area:** The "Recent candidates" section on the right side is currently empty. It displays a placeholder user icon, the bold text **"No candidates yet"**, and the subtext *"Applicants will appear here."*
*   **Zero Values:** The dashboard metrics for "TOTAL APPLICANTS", "SHORTLISTED", and "IN INTERVIEW" are all currently at **0**.

### 4. Layout Structure
The layout follows a standard administrative dashboard design:
*   **Left Sidebar:** A fixed navigation rail with a white background. It contains the "SkillMatch AI" logo at the top, followed by a vertical list of navigation links. The "Dashboard" item is highlighted in purple to indicate the current page.
*   **Top Header Bar:** Spans the width of the screen above the main content. It contains global search, utility icons, and user account information.
*   **Main Content Area:** Occupies the center and right portion of the screen.
    *   **Header Section:** Contains the page title "Hiring overview", a descriptive subtitle, and the primary CTA button.
    *   **Metrics Row:** Four distinct cards displaying key hiring statistics (Active Jobs, Total Applicants, Shortlisted, In Interview).
    *   **Two-Column Grid Below Metrics:**
        *   **Left Column ("Your jobs"):** Lists individual job postings.
        *   **Right Column ("Recent candidates"):** Displays a list or status of recent applicants (currently showing the empty state).

### 5. Specific Text, Labels, Headings, and Numbers
**Branding & User Info:**
*   **Logo:** "SkillMatch AI" / "Skill-based hiring"
*   **User Name:** "David Chen"
*   **User Email:** "employer@demo.com"
*   **Role Label:** "EMPLOYER"

**Headings:**
*   "Hiring overview"
*   "ACTIVE JOBS"
*   "TOTAL APPLICANTS"
*   "SHORTLISTED"
*   "IN INTERVIEW"
*   "Your jobs"
*   "Recent candidates"

**Subtext/Descriptions:**
*   "Track your active jobs, applicants, and interviews."
*   "0 drafts"
*   "Across all jobs"
*   "Awaiting next step"
*   "Active interview stage"
*   "Applicants will appear here."

**Data Points & Job Details:**
*   **Numbers:** 2 (Active Jobs), 0 (Total Applicants), 0 (Shortlisted), 0 (In Interview), 2 (Notification count).
*   **Job 1 Title:** "Backend Engineer (Go)"
*   **Job 1 Location/Date:** "Lagos, Nigeria • posted today"
*   **Job 1 Status:** "Published" (Green label)
*   **Job 2 Title:** "Senior Frontend Engineer"
*   **Job 2 Location/Date:** "Lagos, Nigeria • posted today"
*   **Job 2 Status:** "Published" (Green label)
*   **Empty State Text:** "No candidates yet"
